name: Astraea
intro: Astraea is now a Vox AC30. This is the most detailed pack on the page: the maker captured both channels at many real knob settings. So instead of blending a gain ladder, Volume, Tone Cut, Bass and Treble find the captured setting closest to where your knobs are and load it, blending with the next closest one in between. BOOST adds the treble booster captures on the Normal channel.
notes: NORMAL: 17 captures across Volume 3 to 10 and Tone Cut 0 to 10. TOP BOOST: 75 captures across Volume 2 to 10 with many Bass, Treble and Tone Cut settings.
Tone Cut works like on a real AC30: turning it up takes treble away.
Treble and Bass only exist on the Top Boost channel of a real AC30, so on Normal they are just the plugin EQ.
BOOST: 4 captures with a Dallas-style treble booster in front, taken at Volume 7 and 10. Volume steps through them from mildest to hottest. The pack has none on Top Boost.
All files are amp only, so your cab section works normally. Reverb and Master are plugin controls.

1|1.note: the pack has no Top Boost capture with the treble booster, so BOOST does nothing on this channel
